This file is only accurate if every build updates it (rule in CLAUDE.md).
iPhone may still clear home-screen app data when unused. Cannot be promised away.
Offline mode shows saved data only. Changes made offline do not save.

changelog.text: Save to UNS falls back to a unique name match when the saved LinkedIn link differs, and fixes the saved link.
Intake screen (founder side): forms with short, long and pick questions, responses, close and reopen. Tables intake_forms and intake_responses (migration 0010). Private link page comes later.
Lead panel has a Details block: edit name, company, LinkedIn link, X link and industry after saving.
Phone shell with bottom tabs, a phone Dashboard, Leads, Tasks and Watchlist, built from the approved prototype.
Refresh and reopening bring you back to the last screen with its tabs and filters.
Save to UNS reads the name from the page title, strips headline, credentials and notification count, and shows what it read.
Save to UNS also reads the real name from the LinkedIn page and fixes names guessed from the link.
Save to UNS: a bookmarks-bar button that saves a LinkedIn profile photo to the matching lead or Watchlist person, via the new /avatar/capture API and /app/photo.html.
Paste a LinkedIn photo: open a lead, Ctrl+V. Desktop face click no longer opens a file window first.

X link on leads (migration 0009), Copy link buttons, remembered light or dark. Company markers: people at the same company share a coloured chip with the company name and a count. The lead card lists the others at that company.
Avatars on the leads board and for the signed-in person, coloured initials, tidy phone menu buttons.
Phone basics: login page skipped when signed in, every screen is a back step, session renews, SameSite Lax, service worker and offline bar, install help.
Fix: email now sends through Resend over HTTPS, from mail.unscrollable.studio. Errors show the real reason.
Eye icon, recovery codes, remember this device.
